fullName.title: Full Name
fullName.description: Your full name for personalizing outreach materials and the dashboard.

email.title: Email Address (Optional)
email.description: Where to send your application pack and match report. Leave empty to skip email.

targetRoles.title: Target Roles / Keywords
targetRoles.description: Job titles or target domains (e.g., Data Scientist, UI/UX Designer, Product Designer).

preferredLocations.title: Preferred Work Mode / Location
preferredLocations.description: e.g., Remote, Lagos, Nigeria, Worldwide, Hybrid.

cvText.title: CV / Resume Text
cvText.description: Paste your full CV or career summary text.
cvText.default: Machine learning and software engineer experienced in Python, PyTorch, predictive modeling, data pipelines, and embedded IoT architectures.
cvText.prefill: Machine learning and software engineer experienced in Python, PyTorch, predictive modeling, data pipelines, and embedded IoT architectures.

minScore.title: Minimum Compatibility Score (%)
minScore.description: Only jobs matching at or above this score threshold will be included.

maxPacks.title: Maximum Application Packs to Draft
maxPacks.description: How many tailored cover letters and recruiter DMs to generate for top matches.

resetMemory.title: Reset Memory (Ignore Previously Seen Jobs)
resetMemory.description: Enable this to re-evaluate and clear previously saved job history. Turn off for scheduled runs so you only get new jobs.
